title: Mouse Myocardial Infarction Protocol
author: Lin Zhong
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6xghfjw
materials: Mice are anesthetized with pentobarbital (50 mg.kg, IP).

steps.title: Prepare and Disinfect Mouse
steps.instruction: Shave and disinfect the ventral neck and left parasternal region using Betadine followed by 70% alcohol.

steps.title: Perform Endotracheal Intubation
steps.instruction: Position the mouse supine on a heating pad and establish mechanical ventilation.

substeps.instruction: Make a small incision through the skin underlying the trachea.
Expose the trachea and make a small puncture.
Perform endotracheal intubation using a PE-50 tube.
Connect the endotracheal tube to a small rodent ventilator (Harvard Apparatus).

steps.title: Monitor ECG
steps.instruction: Place ECG electrode leads subcutaneously to monitor the ECG during myocardial infarction (MI).

steps.title: Perform Left Thoracotomy
steps.instruction: Using a surgical microscope, perform a left thoracotomy and enter the fourth intercostal space using scissors and blunt dissection.

steps.title: Ligate Left Anterior Descending Artery
steps.instruction: Place an 8-0 silk suture through the myocardium into the anterolateral left ventricular wall around the left anterior descending (LAD) coronary artery.

steps.title: Induce Myocardial Injury
steps.instruction: Depending on the experimental group, perform one of the following procedures to induce injury:

substeps.instruction: Permanent MI: Tie the suture to permanently ligate the LAD; confirm MI via ECG monitor.
Sham: Perform the procedure without tying the suture around the LAD.

Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury: Place a sterile PE-50 tube against the LAD and tie the suture against the tube. Cover the surgical area with sterile gauze soaked in warm saline during the ischemic period. After the period, remove the tube and cut the LAD ligature to restore blood flow.
Cryoinfarction: Cool a 3 mm diameter cryo-probe in liquid nitrogen for 2 minutes and place it in a circumscribed region of the free LV wall for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Close Chest Cavity
steps.instruction: Close the chest in layers using 7-0 sutures.

steps.title: Wean from Ventilation
steps.instruction: Gradually wean the mouse from the ventilator to resolve any possible pneumothorax.

steps.title: Final Closure and Recovery
steps.instruction: Remove the endotracheal tube once spontaneous respiration resumes and close all incisions.

substeps.instruction: Close the trachea incision with 8-0 suture.
Maintain the mouse on the heating pad until fully recovered from anesthesia.

steps.title: Administer Post-operative Analgesia
steps.instruction: Administer Buprenorphine SC immediately following surgery and every 8-12 hr for 72 hr.
